snippet.description:
Nikhil Sir shares a personal lesson from his UPSC journey. Across six attempts, he reached the Mains and Interview stages, but repeatedly fell ill before important stages of the exam. He even recalls writing Mains after being hospitalised. His message to aspirants is clear: neglecting your health is unnecessary, and taking care of yourself needs to be part of your preparation.
